attacks.name: Plasma Rifle
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Hadron Enforcer
steps: |!wild| |*Vortex|: Before |!damage| is dealt, other enemy characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage| and are Pushed Toward the defender |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Booby Traps
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a movement within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. The enemy character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| result rolled.

superPowers.name: Personal Bodyguard
superPowers.body: When this character is the target of an attack and an allied |*Groot| is within |!range| 2 of this character, this character may use this superpower. The allied |*Groot| becomes the target of the attack regardless of |!range| and LOS.

superPowers.name: Nimble
superPowers.body: This character does not suffer |!damage| from collisions.

superPowers.name: Small Stature
superPowers.body: This character always benefits from Cover.
